phoneLine.q: Do I need a landline for home internet?
phoneLine.a: No. Home plans don't need a landline.

symmetric.a: A connection with the same upload and download speed. With Metro 20, for example, you get 20 Mbps in both directions.

akn.a: The fair-usage threshold ("adil kullanım kotası"): a limit that slows your connection after a certain amount of use. Business plans have no AKN.

faults.q: What do I do if something stops working?
faults.a: Report the fault online and we fix it within 24 hours.

modem.q: Will a modem fee appear on my bill later?
modem.a: No. We never advertise a "free modem" and then add a modem fee to your bill.

business-asymmetric.name: Business asymmetric
business-asymmetric.title: Asymmetric business internet
business-asymmetric.description: Faster down than up. A lower-cost choice for offices that mostly use email, the web and cloud apps.

explainer.title: Symmetric or asymmetric?
explainer.lead: The difference is the upload speed.
explainer.symmetricBody: The same speed up and down. Choose symmetric if you send a lot of data out: video meetings, camera recordings, servers or large files.
explainer.asymmetricBody: Upload is slower than download. A lower-cost choice for offices that mostly use email, the web and cloud apps.
